title: A $p$-part Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Formula over Totally Imaginary Quadratic Extension of Totally Real Fields
summary: This article studies a modular semistable elliptic curve $E$ over a totally real number field $F$ such that, upon base change to a totally imaginary quadratic extension $K$, it has analytic rank one. Assuming the Iwasawa main conjecture, along with a substantial number of assumptions, we prove a variant of the $p$-part of the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer formula over $K$, where $p$ is an odd prime.
